messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired — severity: high — service: inference-hosted — metric: p99 latency 1.8s (SLO 0.6s) — link: https://pagerduty.example/INC-12345

oncall-ops: auto-page fired, routing to on-call

alice: Acked on PD. seeing p99 spike across eu-west and us-west. Traces point to queueing in the batcher sidecar (batch_wait rising).

jordan: Confirming. Looks like kvcache evictions + sudden hotkey traffic. ETA ~5m to divert traffic to smaller model variant as a temporary mitigation.

mike: +1. From logs:
[2026-03-18T10:02:11Z] evict: hotkey=customer-abc count=1250
[2026-03-18T10:02:12Z] batch_wait_ms=1200
Pattern of backpressure on the batcher.

alice: Starting divert now — running quick API call to route fallback variant (will keep for 15m then reassess):
```
curl -X POST https://api.internal.redwood/route/divert \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ONCALL_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"route":"inference-hosted","variant":"gpt-small-quant","duration_s":900}'
```

incident-bot: PagerDuty INC-12345 acknowledged by alice

jordan: Divert applied, cluster confirms new route in control plane. KVCACHE will need ~30s to warm; watchers enabled.

nina: Noted potential customer impact: long-multi-turn prompts might be truncated or slower while model warms. I'll prepare a short customer-facing note if this persists >15m.

alice: Observing metrics — p95 dropped to ~0.42s, p99 down to ~0.72s after divert. Improvement but still close to SLO. Applying batching throttle to limit wait tail.

mike: Applying batcher throttle via patch:
```
PATCH /internal/config/batcher
{"max_wait_ms":50,"max_batch_size":64}
```
Applied to eu-west/us-west sidecars.

oncall-ops: Suppressing duplicate pages for 10m to avoid paging churn while we stabilize (:no_bell:).

jordan: If p99 remains <0.8s for 10m we'll keep the divert and file RCA. If it rebounds, escalate to eng-sre for autoscaler/eviction tuning.

alice: TL;DR: Mitigated via model divert + batcher throttle. Customer impact: brief window of higher latency for very long prompts pre-divert; no user-facing errors observed. Handing off monitoring to next rotation (paul) and opening follow-up RCA ticket.

paul: Taking handoff. I'll keep dashboards on 1min cadence and open INC-12345-RCA in tracker. Anyone want to add notes to the ticket with config diffs?

incident-bot: Incident INC-12345 status: mitigated — monitoring. Page window closed.
